disposition.note: Amount Spent zero-value segments Feb-Mar (70.1x1.7pt) and Aug-Dec (270.7x5.0pt), inspected in 4x 300 DPI GT/output crops and a pixel column profile at x=3500px: native shows 4 teal rows (0.96pt) capped by one grey category-axis row, because the 2.24pt stroke centred on the plot's bottom edge is clipped at the plot rectangle and the axis paints over it; the output draws the full 8-row (1.9pt) unclipped stroke below the axis. Colour, centre and the crisp-disc versus raster-sprite marker rings are unchanged from the #1606 audit. Cluster IDs and bboxes are identical to the committed #1616 report; re-inspected in the 300 DPI diff and 4x crops after the #1617 legend marker cap, which changes only the sub-floor legend key row.
